about: Brand-only Seroquel, Zoloft and Suboxone 8/2 for opioid dependence cover 2 June, with the combination film contributing one opioid group.
Sertraline and methadone with no recorded indication both cover 3 February, when a single dose of short-acting Clopixol Acuphase supplies the third group.
Pregabalin and sertraline cover 22 May, but the Clopixol Depot injection on that day is excluded, leaving two qualifying groups.
